## What's new

- **Make whole cells unwalkable with the map's own cell flag, as in WinDS1.** This needs no tile file, and only the cells you choose change, not other copies of the same tile. It works even when both floor layers of a cell are already used. Use it to close the last gaps, loot traps or spots where characters get stuck.
  - **Ctrl+Shift+right-click** a cell to toggle it. Inside a selection, it toggles every selected cell.
  - Right-click menu: **Make unwalkable (cell flag)** or **Make walkable again (cell flag)**.
  - Selection panel: **Make unwalkable** and **Walkable again**.
  - Cell panel: a **Whole cell unwalkable** checkbox.
  - The flag is bit 17 of the cell. It goes on the cell's Floor 1, or on the first layer with a tile when Floor 1 is empty, and the game blocks walking on the whole cell. A cell with no tile at all can't hold it, so put a floor there first. Each change is one undo step, and the Walkable overview and walkability view show the result right away.
